meta.expect: goes cold; sets the teacher back

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
I'm waiting, Hale. That wasn't an answer.
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence. Claire won her appeal, and she has nothing to do with Owen's essay. Say her name again and this conversation continues in the principal's office.
Maybe this runs in the family.

I'm writing that down, word for word: "Maybe this runs in the family." My children don't lie, Hale, and I'm not sitting here while you call them liars. Either you show me what you actually have on Owen's essay right now, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal with that sentence.
